name: @europa/console
description: Europa Neo client console — satellite-view board rendering, region-based pipe orders, subcell paratroop/gun targeting, reserves control, and modern QoL layer. React 19 SPA consuming @europa/engine, @europa/fog, @europa/terrain, and @europa/networking; server-authoritative (never simulates).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsx scripts/build-assets.ts && tsc && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist/src','dist',{recursive:true})" && node -e "const{readdirSync,cpSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs'),{join,dirname}=require('path');function c(d){for(const e of readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())c(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.css')){const t=join('dist',p.replace(/^src\//, ''));mkdirSync(dirname(t),{recursive:true});cpSync(p,t)}}}c('src')"
scripts.build:lib: tsc && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist/src','dist',{recursive:true})" && node -e "const{readdirSync,cpSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs'),{join,dirname}=require('path');function c(d){for(const e of readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())c(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.css')){const t=join('dist',p.replace(/^src\//, ''));mkdirSync(dirname(t),{recursive:true});cpSync(p,t)}}}c('src')"
